characters: Calumet steelworks bridge operator: middle-aged stocky man with warm brown skin, broad square face, thick dark moustache, amber safety helmet with small unlettered metal bridge-shaped badge, navy industrial jacket, heavy radio headset with short boom microphone. Indiana Harbor night-shift bridge operator: older East Asian woman with silver hair in a short bob tucked behind ear, high cheekbones, round amber spectacles, navy peaked work cap with simple gold bridge badge, teal collared work jacket, radio headset. Sharp, alert, slightly mischievous. Accent teal and brass.

Harbor dispatcher: young adult Black woman with compact braided bun under a red-orange dock cap, expressive eyebrows and rounded face, dark blue utility vest over mustard shirt, single-ear radio headset. Upbeat and confident. Accent coral and gold.

Lock keeper: older white man with a broad ginger-and-gray beard, large friendly nose, weathered face, deep green knit watch cap, brass ear defender headset, olive waterproof work coat with orange collar. Patient and slightly eccentric. Accent forest green and orange.

Fire-rescue barge captain: middle-aged South Asian man, athletic square jaw, neat dark beard with a gray streak, red rescue helmet with plain gold shield emblem without lettering, dark navy rescue coat with gold collar and compact radio earpiece. Calm decisive expression. Accent fire red and gold.
